title: T2S intra-balance movement conceptual model
meaning: The source connects account balances and entries, cash settlement and payments, securities quantities and transfers, clearing/system membership, trade execution and settlement, obligation fulfilment, status reasons and reference identifiers. Shared visual routes carry multiple separate relationships: three BookEntry–CashEntry associations, three SecuritiesBalance–SecuritiesQuantity associations and two ObligationFulfilment–Obligation associations. Their independence is confirmed by FullBusinessModel rows 2063–2065, 2566/2573/2577 and 1203–1204. CashBalance–SystemMemberRole is the Counterparty association (row 1795); it is not another quantity association. IntraPositionTransfer specializes SecuritiesTransfer and links SecuritiesBalance (rows 2583 and 2992–2995). Turned and settled quantity are distinct links to SecuritiesSettlement. The conceptual source does not order activities or assign message senders.

title: T2S securities reference-data conceptual model
meaning: The complete model connects collateral/account reference data with assets, issuance, derivatives, market quantities, securities restrictions, pricing, tax, debt/interest and identification. PartyIdentificationInformation is visibly drawn twice; both occurrences and their separately drawn links are retained. Derivative–Asset combines an overlapping generalization and UnderlyingAsset association, separated using FullBusinessModel!A2367:F2368. Other parallel relationships remain distinct: maximum/minimum market quantities, market listing/trading, debt denomination/increment and extendible/custom periods. The source’s + RelatedYieldCalculation label is located at the YieldCalculation–VariableInterest route and is retained there in this reconstruction. The table instead associates RelatedYieldCalculation with YieldCalculation–RateAndAmount (row 3100); rows 3101 and 2347 define the variable-interest relationship. This discrepancy is explicit and prevents a reviewed status. Displaced GenericIdentification labels were reconciled with exact rows 154, 156, 159 and 164: IdentificationForContactPoint/Identification, OtherIdentification/RelatedPartyIdentification, scheme Identification, and DataSourceScheme/RelatedStatusReason respectively. No numeric cardinalities are printed.
limitations: The source diagram places + RelatedYieldCalculation near YieldCalculation–VariableInterest, while FullBusinessModel row 3100 makes it the opposite end of YieldRange on YieldCalculation–RateAndAmount. Both source claims are retained; endpoint-label interpretation needs review. See issue-000029.
